Trust & Governance

Our Mission

To be the most trusted educational authority in commercial roofing — the first place decision-makers go before making any roofing decision.

The problem we exist to fix

Commercial roofing decisions are expensive, infrequent, and asymmetrical. The people making them — owners, boards, managers — face them a handful of times in a career. The people selling to them face them every day. Almost all available information is published by someone with something to sell.

The result is predictable: premature replacements, mismatched systems, voided warranties, under-documented insurance claims, and millions of dollars in avoidable cost — not because anyone lied, but because no neutral reference existed.

Our mission

We build the neutral reference. CRI publishes source-cited knowledge with transparent methodology — and, as they are validated, decision tools and research datasets — so that every commercial roofing decision can be made on evidence rather than sales pressure.

Our principles

  • Accuracy before speed. We publish when the work is verified, not when the calendar says so.
  • Trust before traffic. We optimize for being right, cited, and returned to — not for clicks.
  • Education before selling. Every page must help the reader decide, whether or not that decision ever benefits us.
  • Evidence, always. We never fabricate. Where evidence is uncertain, we say so plainly.
  • Long-term reputation before short-term revenue. We think in decades.

What success looks like

Success is a facility manager checking CRI before a contractor meeting, an HOA board citing a CRI dataset in a reserve study, an adjuster and an owner using the same CRI reference page — and all of them trusting it because our standards are public and our incentives are disclosed.
